# Fetch all songs from each playlist and identify old songs to remove.
old_songs = [
    "On the Border of Reality by Lily Moon, Zoey James",
    "The Tragedy of Living Without by Marcus Lane",
    "The Shadows That Haunt Us by Carter Knight",
    "Infinite Dreams by Lily Moon",
    "Violet Rain by Noah Bennett, Ethan Wallace, Nova Harmony",
    "Whispers of Destiny by Aria Sterling",
    "Caught in the Afterglow of Love by Grace Harrison",

    "The Melancholy of Wasted Years by Felix Blackwood",
    "In the Theater of Broken Promises by Isabella Cruz",
    "Neon Reverie by Violet Cascade",
    "Longing for a Ghostly Touch by Aria Sterling",

]

def parse_song_entry(entry):
    # entry like "Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    if " by " in entry:
        title = entry.split(" by ")[0].strip()
    else:
        title = entry.strip()
    return title.lower()

old_titles = {parse_song_entry(s) for s in old_songs}

removals = []  # list of (playlist_id, song_id, song_title)

    for song in detail.get("songs", []):
        if song["title"].lower() in old_titles:
            removals.append((pl["playlist_id"], song["id"], song["title"]))

print("Removals found:", len(removals))
for r in removals:
    print(r)

# Remove old songs from existing playlists and add them to Archived Songs.
removed_count = 0
added_count = 0
failed = []

# Use a set to avoid adding duplicate song IDs to archived playlist.
archived_song_ids = set()

for playlist_id, song_id, song_title in removals:
    # Remove from source playlist
    rem = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=song_id, access_token=spotify_access_token)
    if "message" in rem and "error" not in rem.get("message", "").lower():
        removed_count += 1
    else:
        failed.append(("remove", playlist_id, song_id, song_title, rem))
    # Add to archived playlist if not already added
    if song_id not in archived_song_ids:
        add = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=archived_playlist_id, song_id=song_id, access_token=spotify_access_token)
        if "message" in add and "error" not in add.get("message", "").lower():
            archived_song_ids.add(song_id)
            added_count += 1
        else:
            failed.append(("add", archived_playlist_id, song_id, song_title, add))

print("Removed:", removed_count)
print("Added to Archived Songs:", added_count)
print("Failed:", failed)
